verifier_a.independent_derivation_or_calculation: Independent step-by-step verification: Step 1: Universal energy conservation for isolated composite system: dE_universe = 0 => dE_system + dE_surroundings = 0 => dE_system = -dE_surroundings. Step 2: Energy partitioning: Total system energy is partitioned into macroscopic kinetic and potential energy E_macro and microscopic internal energy U: E_system = E_macro + U. For a stationary closed system, dE_macro = 0, so dE_system = dU. Step 3: Energy exchange across boundaries occurs via heat transfer dQ (thermal contact) and work transfer dW (mechanical action): -dE_surroundings = dQ - dW, where dQ is heat absorbed by system and dW is work done by system. Step 4: Equating dE_system = -dE_surroundings gives dU = dQ - dW => dQ = dU + dW. Step 5: For a quasi-static expansion of a fluid system against external boundary pressure P, the infinitesimal mechanical work is dW = P dV. Step 6: Differential First Law becomes dQ = dU + P dV. Limiting cases: Adiabatic (dQ = 0 => dW = -dU); Isochoric (dV = 0 => dQ = dU); Isothermal ideal gas (dT = 0 => dU = 0 => dQ = dW = P dV); Cyclic process (oint dU = 0 => Q = W). Dimensional homogeneity: all terms have dimensions [M L^2 T^-2] (Joules). All 6 steps verified.
findings: Internal energy isolation dE_system = dU verified under stationary assumption.
Differential First Law dQ = dU + dW and dQ = dU + P dV verified.
Limiting cases (adiabatic, isochoric, isothermal, cyclic) verified.
